tool_calls.literal: /bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.stack_frames[0], (if .value>0 then \"bad\" else \"good\" end), (.value|abs)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$1 FS $2; n[k]+=$3} END{for(k in n) print k,n[k]}'"' | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k1,1 -k2,2 && jq -r '[.stack_frames[2], (if .value>0 then \"bad\" else \"good\" end), (.value|abs)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$1 FS $2; n[k]+=$3} END{for(k in n) print k,n[k]}'"' | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k1,1 -k2,2"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -s 'def side: if .value>0 then \"candidate/bad\" else \"base/good\" end; group_by(side) | map({side:(.[0]|side), operations:(map(.value|abs)|add), repeated:(map(select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\")|.value|abs)|add // 0), repeated_rate_pct:((map(select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\")|.value|abs)|add // 0)*100/(map(.value|abs)|add)), sessions:(map(.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length), sessions_with_repeated:(map(select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\")|.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length)})' samples.jsonl && jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [(if .value>0 then \"bad\" else \"good\" end), .stack_frames[2], (.value|abs)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$1 FS $2;n[k]+=$3} END{for(k in n) print k,n[k]}'"' | sort -k3,3nr | head -20"
